correctness.rationale: The same-source two-spin matrix is reconstructed by direct 4x4 evolution and partial trace; conditional qubit Bloch length is c sin²(mφ). The strict binary entropy chord bounds the gap by g(mu), the geometric trigonometric series uniquely maximizes mu at equal couplings and odd-half-turn gate phase, and g is strictly increasing on the physically reachable interval. Equality at every step establishes if-and-only-if optimality and a single σx readout. Reproducibility: 30 direct-matrix comparisons and 20 optimum cases from verify.py pass; finite tests supplement an analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact reset-age Holevo observable is introduced as a measurable single-spin diagnostic in an experimental two-qubit reset study. A globally sharp below-one-third-bit capacity, all attaining Ising couplings and gate phases, and an optimal one-spin σx readout provide a motivated exact benchmark and measurement recipe beyond the generic one-bit bound; the result makes no claim about noisy hardware or longer chains.
